lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's two to one? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 2 to 1? Nope!

lines.text: Sides thirteen, fourteen, fifteen. The circle inside touches B C at D, C A at E.
lines.caption: Sides 13, 14, 15. The circle inside touches BC at D, CA at E.

lines.text: A D and B E cross at P. What is A P to P D?
lines.caption: AD and BE cross at P. What is AP to PD?

lines.text: Each corner's two pieces out to the circle are equal. That gives six, eight, eight, seven.
lines.caption: Each corner's two pieces out to the circle are equal. That gives 6, 8, 8, 7.

lines.text: Weigh the corners so each side balances: B twenty-eight, C twenty-one, A twenty-four.
lines.caption: Weigh the corners so each side balances: B 28, C 21, A 24.

lines.text: Merge B and C: forty-nine at D.
lines.caption: Merge B and C: 49 at D.

lines.text: So A P to P D is forty-nine to twenty-four!
lines.caption: So AP to PD is 49 to 24!

lines.text: Two to one was the trap.
lines.caption: 2 to 1 was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get forty-nine to twenty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 49 to 24? Tell me below!
